certificates.type:
∀ {A : Type u} (R : A → A → Prop) (wf : NativeBridge.ComputationalCorrespondence.ProgramWf.SWf.{u} R) (P : A → Type v)
  (G : Computational.ProgramWf.NativeBridge.Incremental.ProgramWellFounded.NativeStep.{v, u + 1} R P)
  (Q : (x : A) → P x → Type w)
  (I :
    (x : A) →
      ((y : A) → R y x → Q y (NativeBridge.ComputationalCorrespondence.ProgramWf.nativeValue.{u, v} R ⋯ P G y)) →
        Q x (NativeBridge.ComputationalCorrespondence.ProgramWf.nativeValue.{u, v} R ⋯ P G x))
  (x : A) (a : NativeBridge.ComputationalCorrespondence.ProgramWf.SAcc.{u} R x),
  Eq.{w + 1}
    (cast.{w + 1} ⋯
      (Computational.ProgramWf.RocqPending.Corelib.Program.Wf.Fix_F_sub_rect.{u, v, w} A P R wf
        (Computational.ProgramWf.NativeBridge.Incremental.ProgramWellFounded.sourceStep.{u, v} R P G) Q
        (NativeBridge.ComputationalCorrespondence.ProgramWf.fromInvariant.{u, v, w} R wf P G Q I) x a))
    (NativeBridge.ComputationalCorrespondence.ProgramWf.nativeRect.{u, v, w} R ⋯ P G Q I x)

∀ {A : Type u} (R : A → A → Prop) (wf : NativeBridge.ComputationalCorrespondence.ProgramWf.SWf.{u} R) (P : A → Type v)
  (G : Computational.ProgramWf.NativeBridge.Incremental.ProgramWellFounded.NativeStep.{v, u + 1} R P)
  (Q : (x : A) → P x → Type w)
  (I :
    (x : A) →
      ((y : A) → R y x → Q y (NativeBridge.ComputationalCorrespondence.ProgramWf.nativeValue.{u, v} R ⋯ P G y)) →
        Q x (NativeBridge.ComputationalCorrespondence.ProgramWf.nativeValue.{u, v} R ⋯ P G x))
  (x : A),
  Eq.{w + 1}
    (cast.{w + 1} ⋯
      (Computational.ProgramWf.RocqPending.Corelib.Program.Wf.Fix_sub_rect.{u, v, w} A P R wf
        (Computational.ProgramWf.NativeBridge.Incremental.ProgramWellFounded.sourceStep.{u, v} R P G) ⋯ Q
        (NativeBridge.ComputationalCorrespondence.ProgramWf.fromSubInvariant.{u, v, w} R wf P G Q I) x))
    (NativeBridge.ComputationalCorrespondence.ProgramWf.nativeRect.{u, v, w} R ⋯ P G Q I x)
